scenes.text: Start on one quiet stretch of coast, and keep pulling back.
Earth is about twelve thousand seven hundred kilometres across.
The Moon circles it at an average of three hundred and eighty four thousand kilometres.
Sunlight needs about eight minutes and twenty seconds to reach us.
The nearest other star, Proxima Centauri, is four point two light-years away.
Our Milky Way is about a hundred thousand light-years across.
It belongs to the Local Group, alongside the Andromeda and Triangulum galaxies.
And the observable universe spans about ninety-three billion light-years.

props.title: From one beach to the edge of *everything*
